commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- identity/os ---'
id
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- network state ---'
ip -4 addr show
ip route show
printf '%s\n' '--- resolv.conf metadata/content ---'
ls -l /etc/resolv.conf
readlink -f /etc/resolv.conf || true
cat /etc/resolv.conf
printf '%s\n' '--- network services ---'
for s in NetworkManager systemd-networkd networking systemd-resolved resolvconf cloud-init; do printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s-enabled=' "$s"; systemctl is-enabled "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; done
printf '%s\n' '--- system health ---'
systemctl is-system-running || true
printf '%s\n' '--- persistent config candidates ---'
for f in /etc/network/interfaces /etc/network/interfaces.d/* /etc/systemd/network/* /etc/NetworkManager/NetworkManager.conf /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/* /etc/resolvconf/resolv.conf.d/*; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then printf '\n### %s\n' "$f"; sed -n '1,240p' "$f"; fi; done
printf '%s\n' '--- DNS functional check ---'
getent ahostsv4 debian.org | sed -n '1,6p'
